The idea of it is such a relaxing and peaceful feeling. Not bound or limited by anything nor anyone. No more people to judge you, obstruct your line of vision, nor disrupt you with their disgusting humanly sounds. Life without people is great.

This is why I stay up late, so that I can enjoy the peacefulness of being alone. It makes a bit less sense now that I live alone, but before, when I had roommates or still lived with family, each night I waited around until everyone else had gone to sleep so that I could finally relax and do my own thing without any interruption.
